requiredGates.name: frontend-accessibility
requiredGates.evidence: React Testing Library role/name coverage for shell, tickets, Kanban and dashboard

requiredGates.name: e2e-browser-smoke
requiredGates.evidence: Playwright smoke paths for requester ticket creation, Kanban workflow controls and dashboard charts

requiredGates.name: backend-security
requiredGates.evidence: Spring Boot authorization and sensitive-response regression tests

requiredGates.name: privacy-metadata
requiredGates.evidence: Repository privacy validator reports zero findings

requiredGates.name: analytics-contract-robustness
requiredGates.evidence: Malformed, minimal, low-confidence, no-match, candidate-limit and deterministic suggestion contracts

requiredGates.name: backend-analytics-resilience
requiredGates.evidence: Analytics success, timeout, unavailable, malformed-response and audit-only review decision coverage

requiredGates.name: frontend-analytics-review
requiredGates.evidence: Advisory suggestion display, accept, ignore, override, loading and failure states

requiredGates.name: analytics-e2e-advisory-review
requiredGates.evidence: Playwright smoke path for explicit advisory suggestion review before ticket mutation

requiredGates.name: privacy-unsafe-analytics-logging
requiredGates.evidence: No unsafe logging patterns or private-data fixtures in analytics quality files

manualKeyboardSmoke: Use the skip link to move focus to main content.
Tab through primary navigation and verify the active route is announced.
Tab through /tickets filters, create form and Kanban status controls.
Change a Kanban status with the select control and activate Apply with the keyboard.
Tab through /dashboard date and granularity filters and refresh metrics.
Tab through advisory analytics suggestion actions and verify review buttons are reachable.
outOfScope: Automatic ticket mutation from analytics suggestions
